head: codex/512-observatory-redesign-implementation
title: [v0.92.1][OBS-B] Implement the redesigned Observatory
body:
Closes #512

## Summary

- Implements the redesigned Runtime v3 Observatory with multi-polis selection, hash-addressable views, responsive layout, and accessible inspector navigation.
- Keeps polis-scoped state isolated across endpoint switches and prevents stale asynchronous results from rendering into a newly selected polis.
- Removes browser exposure of durable master logs; the Logs view is derived from the bounded selected-polis Observatory event projection.
- Preserves Runtime orientation-package visibility and documents the local/public deployment configuration.

## Validation

- `node --check demos/html-observatory/app.js` — passed.
- `node --test demos/html-observatory/tests/*.test.mjs` — passed, 20/20.
- `bash adl/tools/test_html_observatory.sh` — passed.
- `node adl/tools/validate_v092_observatory_transcript_history.mjs` — passed.
- `bash adl/tools/validate_layer8_authority_observatory_ui.sh` — passed, 8/8.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Live Runtime v3 readiness endpoint reported ready/running with no degraded reasons.

## Review

- Independent exact-head review passed with no P0-P3 findings at `f431621f9dd246a918f295020cd53e3c3e265a9c`.
- Interactive browser automation was unavailable because its trusted RPC dependency failed to resolve; no automated interactive-browser pass is claimed. The operator has separately inspected the running site.

## Mixed-mode shadow

- Typed v2 remains authoritative for this issue.
- A v3 doctor shadow was attempted and retained as non-authoritative evidence; it is blocked by a v3 shadow-normalizer/output-schema mismatch and did not perform provider side effects.
